title.narrative: Stories of Palestine - Palestinian communities promote their culture

description.narrative: Overall Objective: Enhance civil society engagement in preserving, reinforcing and promoting the Palestinian culture.Specific Objective: Strengthen contribution of Adult Education Centres in Palestinian rural areas and areas that are less exposed to the various artistic expressions in fostering cultural education and action. Outputs:1.Eight community-based adult education centres have enhanced capacities in provision of cultural education and cultural actions that promote local cultural heritage, active civic engagement of local women, men and youth, and values of tolerance and respect of cultural diversity.2.Engagement of the targeted communities in cultural and artistic expression is enhanced through increased opportunities for quality local cultural education and action.3.Public awareness about the Palestinian cultural heritage and narrative is improved through a mobile cultural festival implemented by the eight targeted communities and visiting three Palestinian cities and six cultural and adult education centres in three European countries

description.narrative: Eight communitybased adult education centres are recognised by community members and decision makers on local and national level as actors in preserving, reinforcing and promoting Palestinian culture.

comment.narrative: One main indicator of the centres success in becoming active cultural actors is an increased public recognition of them and exposure dialogue and exchange in the cultural arena. Major positive changes were achieved comparing the situation of AECs regarding their cultural intervention in their communities before and after the project. The AECs now perceive themselves as cultural operators in the Palestinian cultural scene especially when it comes to communitybased cultural learning in preserving reinforcing and promoting Palestinian culture and local heritage. They are also seen as such by other cultural and community actors and by the community members. This becomes evident in the types of cooperation and joint events the AECs were able to organise alongside other local and national actors.
